question: What destructive power over the entire triple world is attributed to the angered adept?
premises: The adept is described as angry
The action is the destruction or withdrawal of all
The scope includes the triple world with moving and unmoving beings
inference: When angry, the adept may destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings
uncertainties: saṃharet can mean withdraw or destroy depending on context
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the entire triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
